R7AC-grouse-drive-0003.name: By Cushing Creek
R7AC-grouse-drive-0003.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7AC-grouse-drive-0003.parkWhat: pull off on Cushing Mainline (gravel road)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
8 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
32 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

plan: Drive: from Village of Valemount, about 154 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.66944, -120.36387, pull off on Cushing Mainline (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Cushing Mainline stretch, 6.6 km one way. About 132 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
